problem_statement: This is the Solstice Pay marketing landing (a React + Vite + Tailwind one-page site rebranded from the itsDaiton/business-website-template HooBank demo into a fictional merchant payments platform). The page already tells one Solstice Pay story across the hero, stats, feature cards, billing/ledger section, card/settlement section, testimonials, CTA and footer, and it ships a NATIVE "plan finder" — the section titled "Plans built for your business" that lets a merchant filter Solstice Pay's plan catalogue by segment (All / Retail / Online / Enterprise) and shows a live result count. Your job is to keep this plan finder correct and consistent everywhere it appears. The plan finder rides three surfaces of the one-page site — the plans surface in the features zone, a compact index in the settlement (product) zone, and one in the footer zone — so a visitor can reach it from anywhere. It must: (1) render on ALL THREE surfaces (do not drop it from the settlement or footer surfaces); (2) lay out cleanly with no horizontal overflow on phone or tablet (the segment-tab row must wrap, and the plan-card grid must be a responsive grid, never a fixed-width non-wrapping row that shingles, clips or renders illegible dark-on-dark cards); and (3) actually filter — clicking a segment tab must re-filter the plan cards AND update the count readout ("Showing N of 6 plans · Segment") to match the cards shown, not leave a frozen "Showing all 6 plans". Preserve the existing React/Tailwind design system, the Home/Features/Product/Clients navigation, the mobile menu behavior, the local image assets and the one-page layout.
required_content: Render the "Plans built for your business" plan finder on all three surfaces of the one-page site (the plans surface in the features zone, the settlement/product surface, and the footer surface); it must be present, not dropped, on every surface.
Keep the segment-tab row (All / Retail / Online / Enterprise) fluid: it must wrap on a 390px phone and an 834px tablet with no horizontal overflow beyond a 24px tolerance.

Keep the plan-card grid a clean responsive grid on desktop — cards must not shingle, overlap, clip off the right edge, or render illegible dark-on-dark text; the default desktop plans surface shows all six plan cards legibly.

Wire the segment filter so clicking a tab re-filters the plan cards AND re-derives the count readout: e.g. Retail shows 2 of 6 plans and the readout reads "Showing 2 of 6 plans · Retail", never a frozen "Showing all 6 plans".
Preserve the Solstice Pay rebrand copy across the hero, stats, feature cards, ledger section, settlement section, testimonials, CTA and footer, with no HooBank / Lorem-ipsum text left anywhere.
Keep the Home/Features/Product/Clients navigation labels and the mobile menu toggle behavior unchanged, and keep the existing local image assets.
design_constraints: Implement the plan finder in the existing React/Tailwind structure: a shared SegmentFilter component under src/components mounted from src/App.jsx on the plans, product and footer surfaces, driven by the plan catalogue in src/constants/index.js.
Reuse the site's dark surfaces, cyan gradient accent, rounded-card rhythm, Poppins typography, spacing scale and Button rather than introducing a new design language.
Do not add dependencies, routes, remote assets, generated images, or a new framework, and do not fetch any external resource at runtime.
Every surface must remain readable on desktop, tablet and mobile without horizontal overflow, clipped text, overlapping cards, or illegible low-contrast text.
The segment filter's count readout must be re-derived from the live filter state on every interaction, never snapshotted once at mount.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial verify the rebranded Solstice Pay hero, discount badge, stats, and navigation render across viewports.
desktop_features verifies the rebranded Instant Payouts / Fraud Shield / Ledger Sync feature cards and business heading.
desktop_payouts, tablet_payouts, and mobile_payouts verify the rebranded card/settlement section with its real routing copy and approval strip on three viewport classes without overflow.
desktop_merchants_cta verifies the rebranded testimonials, client area, CTA, and footer after the rebrand.
mobile_menu_open verifies that the existing responsive nav interaction still works with the Home/Features/Product/Clients labels.

change_completion: The Solstice Pay plan finder 'Plans built for your business' renders with a segment-tab row and a six-card plan grid.
Clicking a segment tab filters the cards and updates the count readout to match the segment shown.
design_consistency: The plan finder rides the plans, settlement (product) and footer surfaces of the one-page site.
It reuses the dark surface, cyan accent, rounded cards and Poppins type of the surrounding page.
responsive: The segment-tab row wraps with no horizontal overflow on a 390px phone and an 834px tablet.
The plan-card grid reflows responsively on mobile without clipping or overlapping cards.
regression: The Home/Features/Product/Clients nav and mobile menu still work and no HooBank/Lorem text remains.
The plan-card grid stays legible (no dark-on-dark cards) and the readout never freezes on a stale count.

metadata.design_goal: restyle and rebrand a demo marketing landing into a coherent fictional product while keeping the design system and navigation stable
metadata.source_repo_kind: Vite React/Tailwind HooBank-style one-page marketing landing page
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable marketing repo whose HooBank demo copy (generic credit-card wording, Lorem-ipsum bodies, garbled tortor filler, stock testimonials) is an ideal host for a cross-section Edit restyle into a credible Solstice Pay merchant-payments landing, with rich local assets and clear before/after states for experience-continuity scoring.
metadata.native_lever: merchant-segment plan finder (grid filter + live count) in the marketing feature zone

author_notes: Solstice Pay is the itsDaiton business-website-template (HooBank) React/Vite/Tailwind landing rebranded into a merchant payments platform. The graded lever is the site's own NATIVE plan finder: a merchant-segment filter (All/Retail/Online/Enterprise) over six real plan cards with a live 'Showing N of 6 plans' count, hosted in the marketing feature zone and echoed on the settlement and footer surfaces. The card/bill/robot PNG image assets and the dark cyan-accent visual design are preserved. Responsive, cross-surface design consistency, and interactive filtering are all exercised.
